title: Giving Birth
summary: Жирэмсэн хоёр эмэгтэй эмчид эрт очиж, эрүүл хүүхэд төрүүлсэн түүх.

source.name: LIDA Stories

changes: Images and audio removed; the picture-book pages were joined into paragraphs (one page per paragraph).

questions.prompt: What is the text mostly about?
options: Two women getting health care when pregnant
Two women looking for work in Europe
Two doctors working in a hospital in Italy
questions.explain: Селамавит, Инга хоёр жирэмсэн байхдаа эмч, эх баригчид үзүүлж, "Both women gave birth to healthy babies" гэж төгссөн.

questions.prompt: What did the doctor find out about Selamawit?
options: She had a kind of diabetes.
She was going to have twins.
She had to take folic acid.
questions.explain: Эмч шинжилгээ хийгээд "Selamawit had a kind of diabetes that some pregnant women get" гэж олсон. Folic acid уухыг Ингад зөвлөсөн.

options: Help for babies after they are born
questions.explain: Текстэд "This means that they will get help during their pregnancies" гэж тайлбарласан.
